modifications: Filtered to Biochemistry; HTML and whitespace cleaned; the source's dropped 'rt' letters restored; duplicates (within and across subjects), keyless and figure-dependent items removed; textbook references and page locators removed from explanations; mapped to PrepNucleus modules; difficulty tagged. Structured explanations (topic notes, a reason per option, a pearl) added to items whose explanation was missing or short: StewardMD, auto-checked.
subject: Biochemistry

exp-letter.en: The explanation names a different option letter than the key
exp-letter.hi: व्याख्या में बताया गया विकल्प-अक्षर उत्तर-कुंजी से अलग है

exp-text.en: The explanation restates a different option than the key
exp-text.hi: व्याख्या उत्तर-कुंजी से अलग विकल्प का उल्लेख करती है

dup-key.en: The source holds this question twice with different keys
dup-key.hi: स्रोत में यह प्रश्न दो बार है और उत्तर-कुंजी अलग-अलग हैं

dup-stem.en: The same question stem appears elsewhere with a different key
dup-stem.hi: यही प्रश्न-वाक्य कहीं और अलग उत्तर-कुंजी के साथ मिलता है

disputed.en: An independent blind solve chose a different answer than the key
disputed.hi: स्वतंत्र जाँच ने उत्तर-कुंजी से अलग उत्तर चुना
